fact_text: In an uptrend the analyst draws the trend line by joining two successive higher lows, then extends it forward as the reference line for later price action.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: In a downtrend the analyst joins the lower highs and lower lows that form, and the resulting line acts as resistance where price is rejected and falls back.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: When drawing a trend line on candlesticks the analyst counts the wicks (shadows), not the real bodies, so the line joins wick to wick and the body is not cut through.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: An alternative method is to switch the chart to line mode, join the highest or lowest closing points there, then switch back to candlesticks, where the same line should still hold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: A parallel channel tool draws a band around the trend line; the analyst notes a false breakout when price leaves the band and then moves back inside the trend line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: The analyst keeps the existing trend line until new higher highs and higher lows, or new lower highs and lower lows, appear, and only then redraws the line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)

fact_text: The analyst warns against acting the moment price touches a trend line; he waits for indicator or candle-pattern confirmation, because a direct entry can be stopped out if the line breaks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '4. Master Trend Lines: How to Draw Trend Lines Accurately | Stock Analysis & Market Analysis Tips' (YouTube, 2024-09-01)
